query: My 42‑year‑old female: among female ICU patients aged 37–47 with ARDS (first ICU stay), what is the minimum diagnostic utilization (distinct procedures during first 72 hours)? Compare to all ICU patients and report P75/P90, mean hospital LOS and in‑hospital mortality.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.age, s.first_careunit, s.los, COUNT(DISTINCT i.procedure_id) AS num_procedures, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT i.procedure_id)) AS p75_procedures, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT i.procedure_id)) AS p90_procedures, AVG(s.los) AS avg_los, SUM(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inhospital_mortality_rate FROM patients p JOIN icustays s ON p.subject_id = s.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON s.subject_id = d.subject_id JOIN procedures_icd i ON s.subject_id = i.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.age BETWEEN 37 AND 47 AND s.first_careunit = 'ICU' AND d.icd_code = '426.0' AND i.chartdate BETWEEN s.intime AND s.outtime AND i.procedure_id IN (SELECT procedure_id FROM procedures_icd WHERE chartdate BETWEEN s.intime AND s.outtime) GROUP BY p.gender, p.age, s.first_careunit, s.los;
